verdict.rationale: ADK is explicitly code-first: agents, tools, and orchestration are defined in Python (or Java/Go/Kotlin) via the API, and the Web/dev UI is described as a testing/debugging layer built on top of that same agent code, with CLI equivalents (adk run, adk web, adk eval, adk deploy) mirroring UI actions like running, evaluating, and deploying agents. This implies strong API/code parity with anything visible in the UI. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement or independent audit confirming 1:1 feature parity between the dev UI and the API/CLI, and no evidence of a public REST/OpenAPI surface (probe shows no openapi.json) beyond the Python/CLI layer.
